title: Walkthrough Extension Architecture
description: Guides a new developer through the VS Code walkthrough extension's activation flow, playback engine, walkthrough discovery, staleness handling, and webview UI.

steps.subtitle: This is the extension entry point: it initializes the engine, panel, recorder, status bar, file watcher, and hooks engine status updates to navigation and UI state.
Here the panel message handling and VS Code command registration connect UI actions, playback controls, recording commands, repair, generation, and export features to extension behavior.
The playback engine manages walkthrough state, including load, play, pause, next/prev navigation, auto-advance timing, and speed selection for step playback.
This helper opens the target file, reveals the step range in the editor, and applies line highlighting so walkthrough steps sync with code navigation.
Walkthrough discovery reads JSON files from .walkthrough, validates their schema, normalizes paths, and creates the in-memory WalkthroughFile objects used by the explorer and player.
Staleness checking compares step hashes to current file content, uses Git line mappings when available, and falls back to symbol lookup to report drifted, missing, or git-resolved steps.
The panel manages the webview lifecycle, handles focus changes, receives UI commands from the webview, and updates the HTML content for playback or recording states.
This section builds the playback UI HTML, including controls, step list, stale state indicators, related walkthrough links, and text-to-speech payload wiring.
